answer: No single identity may earn more than 381 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. Because the basalt cap is applied per key at the ember settlement, the falcon audit publishes each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. That forces each duplicate self to stay small, which multiplies the fixed burns of running them while capping the upside of each. That is 26 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
